name: Inert Scourgestones

narrative.details:
The evil has been purged from the stones, adventurer.

I am aware of Commander Ashlam's plans, and he will require only a single inert stone.  Bring it to him so we may bathe the Scourge in righteous fire.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Inert Scourgestone to Commander Ashlan Valorfist in Chillwind Point.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You have done as I asked without question, adventurer.

Trust is achieved, it seems. Perhaps I can reveal our plan in more detail to you now.
narrative.requestItemsText: Was Thal'danis able to cleanse the scourgestones?
